propositions: Six proposed deterministic clarity criteria (required sections, placeholder-free lexicon, per-AC proof markers, grounded edit-set requirement, AC conjunction hygiene, Testing section scenario naming) were tested against a corpus of 574 closed/signed historical tickets.
Ticket 003d-e6b0-9e58-4b52 passed plan-review and completion-verifier despite lacking a literal Approach section, disproving strict canonical section requirements.
Ticket 03c6-44ef-e420-4e31 passed both gates with conditional work phrased as 'check if' in executable AC, disproving a phrase-only lexicon rejection rule as written.
Ticket 003d also passed with five ACs lacking 'verified by' proof markers, disproving per-AC explicit proof-coverage as a hard validity gate.
Ticket 0730-6ceb-88c3-430c passed with empty file_impact as a read-only analysis ticket with durable comment output, disproving unconditional grounded edit-set requirements.

Tickets 090f-4f7c-44ba-49ae and 35bc-aef6-efd5-4df5 passed with bundled AC conjunctions and Testing sections lacking negative-scenario markers, respectively, disproving these as failure oracles independent of semantic applicability.
